content_rules: Use actual project decisions: KDE Plasma desktop, Android mobile and PebbleOS watch; easy everyday use, interface experiments and eventual shared state/actions.
Basic-app examples do not form a closed inventory or fixed priority list.
Flexible stages have no dates: replaceable apps; dependable stable editions alongside deliberate experimental editions; deeper platform work with exact form undecided.
The ecosystem goal is open source; current Pebble releases retain PolyForm Noncommercial terms.
Keep exact public release, download, licence and relationship metadata authoritative and distinct from local candidates.
Current Pebble activity sharing does not establish completed desktop-phone-watch synchronization.
Phone and its optional watch companion are one planned piece of work, without fabricated interfaces or builds.
Xef starts the first stage; later stages need contributors, not an invented existing team.
No Lab, logo, empty future-platform portals or extra Docs landing page.
Keep existing useful URLs and article fragments working, with new links going directly to canonical content.

Phone remains future project/proposal content: no standalone Home promotion, catalogue plan card or explicit Android-plans footer link. Offer catalogue filters only for platforms with available software.

research.observation: Project identity and distinct software within a broader ecosystem.
Explain connections through recognizable outcomes such as sharing files and controlling music.
Accurate Pebble Time 2 device reference for original artwork.
Readable product presentation and direct action hierarchy.
Material density suited to the task.

validation: Final rebuild verification is recorded in docs/qa/VALIDATION.json after checks complete; retained historical reports describe their own source.
